name: RC-B10-0324/2025/REV1 – § 10 – Am 5
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on tackling China’s critical raw materials export restrictions
part_text: 10. Underlines the need for the EU to mine domestically through publicly owned entities and re-establish processing capacity while ensuring that the populations affected consent, and stresses that these activities should be carried out solely for the purposes of implementing the green transition and strengthening European autonomy in strategic sectors*; underlines that increasing the efficiency of resource use through technological innovation is one of the objectives of the CRMA; emphasises the potential of recycling and urban mining to alleviate supply constraints in the short term and asks the Commission to take immediate measures to improve the collection and retention of REEs in the internal market;
